misprints.note: No breathing is visible on the initial eta in the scan. I kept it without the breathing, but it could also be broken type.
The print has an acute, not a grave, before the parenthesis. I kept it as printed.

uncertain.note: The eta has an odd stroke below it. It could be ῄ (iota subscript) or just the descender of η. I wrote ή to match ἀποθνήσκειν on the same page.
The mark after the first 3 is small and could be a period or a comma. I read it as a comma.
Only an acute is visible on άδος, with no breathing (the same applies to ίδος in 0191_01 and 0191_03). I kept it as printed.
